name: MCPJam platform-paid AI spend >$25/h
description: PAGE · MCPJam-paid included AI settled more than $25 in the last hour — a full org lane per hour.
TRIAGE — open View Query, replace the last two lines with:
| summarize Usd=round(sum(actualMicros)/1000000.0,2), Attempts=dcount(eventKey) by feature, org | sort by Usd desc
one org, one feature → a runaway caller; its $25 lane caps it
many orgs, one feature → a busy release or a loop in that feature
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: included generation and analyses are MCPJam's money with no customer allowance in front of them. The per-org ($25) and per-feature ($250) lanes cap the day; this says how fast the day is being spent.

WHY ATTEMPTS, NOT USAGE ROWS: usage records dedupe on the LOGICAL job id, so a retried provider attempt is invisible there. platform_lane_settled fires once per attempt (idempotent settle, stable eventKey), and the max-by-eventKey step drops a duplicated log line. Summing usage totals on top would count the same money twice.

WHY THIS THRESHOLD: PROVISIONAL. Measured included spend before the flips was well under $1/day. Re-baseline after seven days: | summarize Usd=sum(actualMicros)/1000000.0 by bin(_time, 1h) | summarize max(Usd), percentile(Usd, 95).

SOURCE IS NEW: emitted by mcpjam-backend #1463 (lane events, usage funding) and #1470 (snapshot). Until both are in PROD this query returns no rows — an Above monitor stays silent and the deadman would page falsely. Apply only after the prod deploy, with --only <key>.
